acceptance: run.py is split along an existing seam so it is comfortably under the limit, with no behaviour change and tests passing.
context: Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone. Related items share one feature branch and PR where their files overlap. No live-cloud runs and no credentials in Git or logs; heavy work only through lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status. Follow the comment policy and add a changelog.d fragment for user-facing changes. Re-verify every cited file and line before acting; they are hints. Stop and report rather than widen scope.
description: Problem: run.py is 3036 lines, exactly at its module size limit, so the next change there needs an offset or allowlist entry. Several recent changes (guard, driver gate, non-interactive plumbing) grew it.
